info.name: Trip Job Scheduler
info.description: Calls against the docker compose demo (README Quick start). Run the folders in order: 0 mints dev tokens into collection variables, 1 creates the tenants. Requests match scheduler-app's controllers and JwtSecurityConfig, and docs/sink-api.md.

item.name: 0. Dev tokens
item.description: POST /dev/token exists only in the `dev` Spring profile. Never enable it in production.

Create recurring roster job, 01:30 New York (DST overlap on 1 Nov 2026)

request.description: Five-field cron in the tenant zone. On 1 Nov 2026 01:30 happens twice; it fires once, at the first (05:30Z).

item.name: Create recurring job, 02:30 on 14 March (DST gap 2027)

request.description: 02:30 does not exist on 14 Mar 2027 in New York; next-fire-times shows 03:00 local (07:00Z).

Next fire time in the spring-forward gap
List runs of the one-off job

request.description: There is no list-jobs endpoint; this is the run history of one job. Saves the newest runId.

item.name: Trigger again with the same key: same run, duplicate true
Retry the same request: original response, Idempotent-Replayed

request.description: Only flips tenant.paused; runs stay SCHEDULED and the claim skips the tenant. Optional Idempotency-Key.
Late runs are handled by each job's misfire policy when they are claimed.
Returns configuredCap, effectiveCap (slot rows) and draining. Range 0-10,000. No force option.

item.name: 5. Dead letters and replay
item.description: Make every sink delivery fail, let a run use up its 5 attempts (full-jitter backoff, about a minute), list it, clear the fault and replay it with the same idempotency key.

item.name: Create a one-off alert due in 30 s (FIRE_NOW, so the replay runs)

request.description: FIRE_NOW on purpose: replay keeps the original scheduled_at, so a SKIP job replayed more than 60 s late would be SKIPPED, not run.

item.name: Create a job with a bad payload (INVALID_PAYLOAD at once)

request.description: The API only checks that the payload is a JSON object; the handler rejects it and the run is dead-lettered after one attempt.

item.name: List dead letters of tenant A (OPERATOR)

request.description: Error codes and counts only, never payloads. Saves the newest unreplayed SINK_5XX run.
